notes.title: Free!
notes.content:
Hi
Thanks to Everyone who bought the game and thereby supported me.
Yes, something happened to do well, something not. I got different reviews on the game. But it's silly to be offended, I thought. And I decided to make the game free. 
Community, this is for You.
Enjoy

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
Halloween is coming!
Specially for Halloween I've prepared a grand update package:

      Trading cards
      New horror elements
      Lighting system changed, new visual effects added
      New sound effects
      Bugs fixed

The game became more scary and dynamic. And what else do you need in the dark autumn evenings;)

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
Halloween is coming!
Special for Halloween I have prepared the grand package of changes:

    Trading cards have been added
    New horror-elements have been added
    The lighting system has been changed, visual effects have been added 
    Some sound effects have been improved, new one added
    Bugs fixed
 
The game has become more terrible and dynamic. And what else do you need in the dark autumn evenings;)
